articles.title: JPMorgan shuttered its banking relationship with predictions platform Polymarket: FT
articles.snippet: According to Financial Times, JPMorgan ended its banking relationship with Polymarket in late 2025 over regulatory concerns.

articles.title: Ireland plans industry standards for illicit crypto use
articles.snippet: The proposed policies under Ireland’s AML framework included stricter measures on transfers from private crypto wallets and overseas digital asset companies.

articles.title: JPMorgan cuts Polymarket banking ties over regulatory concerns: Report
articles.snippet: JPMorgan Chase reportedly cut banking ties with Polymarket in October 2025 over regulatory concerns but remains open to an underwriting role if the platform goes public.

articles.title: Kalshi Ordered to Block Washington Bets Days After CFTC Backed It
articles.snippet: A King County judge gave the exchange until August 19 to stop offering sports, election and politics wagers in the state.
